headline: US Senate Committee Questions Accounting Giants Over Malta Tax Advice
summary: Senate Finance Committee Democrat Ron Wyden has asked the four major accounting firms to describe their tax advice in Malta concerning corporate tax avoidance.
why: U.S. Senate committees hold oversight powers to investigate cross-border corporate tax practices and the role of major accounting firms.

impacts.name: Professional Services
impacts.why: Congressional scrutiny into offshore tax strategies creates regulatory and reputational risks for major auditing firms.
